subject: [PATCH v5 13/19] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed two issues flagged by Sashiko: closing the sync[0] file descriptor to prevent fd leak and correctly handling the waitpid() return value.

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new test case for the selftests/mm module, specifically targeting a shared-source collapse write race condition in CoW (Copy-On-Write) isolation. The test checks that CoW keeps the child process seeing the pre-fork content while the parent writes to the shared range throughout the child's collapse. The patch adds a new function, `collapse_fork_cow_race`, which simulates this scenario by having the parent unshare one page every 10ms and write to the shared range in bursts.
